body: Planning note (2026-11-12): a new draft epic, "Capabilities: find, install, run and explain third-party agent tools per folder" (ep_01m798d4xrx42x7zzsrxpk8w2k), builds a shared surface for local agent tools: a lockfile-pinned private install, a managed process service, per-folder on/off and a folder-page card. DM-542 in this epic installs its own agent-desktop runtime separately. This saved plan was not changed. Open decision for the person: leave the two independent, or redraft DM-542 and DM-547 to reuse the Capabilities surface if that epic runs first. Desktop control keeps its own consent, expiry and Stop either way.
